sentences.en: They spent their savings to ______ the old farmhouse into a cozy home.
sentences.zh: 他們花光積蓄,將這棟老舊的農舍整修成一個溫馨的家。

sentences.en: The city council approved funds to ______ the crumbling library building.
sentences.zh: 市議會核准了經費,以整修這座逐漸崩塌的圖書館建築。

sentences.en: The scientist earned worldwide ______ for her breakthrough discovery.
sentences.zh: 這位科學家因其突破性的發現而贏得了世界性的聲望。

sentences.en: The chef's restaurant grew in ______ after receiving a prestigious award.
sentences.zh: 在獲得一項享有盛譽的獎項後,這位主廚的餐廳聲望日益提升。

sentences.en: His public ______ of violence surprised many former followers.
sentences.zh: 他公開放棄暴力的聲明讓許多昔日的追隨者感到意外。

sentences.en: The prince's ______ of the throne shocked the entire kingdom.
sentences.zh: 這位王子放棄王位的舉動震驚了整個王國。

words.root_note: re- (again) + occur, from Latin occurrere (to run to meet)

sentences.en: Doctors warned the symptoms might ______ within a few months.
sentences.zh: 醫生警告這些症狀可能在幾個月內再次發生。

sentences.en: Engineers redesigned the system to ensure the failure would not ______ .
sentences.zh: 工程師重新設計了這套系統,以確保這項故障不會再次發生。

words.defn_en: a variant spelling of reoccurrence, the act of happening again:
words.root_note: re- (again) + occur, from Latin occurrere (to run to meet)

sentences.en: The company implemented new safeguards to prevent a ______ of the outage.
sentences.zh: 這家公司實施了新的防護措施,以防止這場停機事故再次發生。

sentences.en: A ______ of the flooding would devastate the already fragile community.
sentences.zh: 這場洪水若再次發生,將會摧毀這個原本就脆弱的社區。

words.defn_en: to desire to make amends, regret:

sentences.en: He ______ed his harsh words and apologized the next day.
sentences.zh: 他為自己說過的重話感到後悔,並在隔天道了歉。

sentences.en: The character in the story ______s his past sins before he dies.
sentences.zh: 故事中的這個角色在臨終前為自己過去的罪過懺悔。

sentences.en: The ______ thief returned the stolen money along with a written apology.
sentences.zh: 這名悔改的小偷歸還了偷竊的錢,並附上一封道歉信。

sentences.en: She seemed truly ______ for the pain her words had caused.
sentences.zh: 她似乎對自己言語造成的傷害感到真心懊悔。

words.defn_en: an unintended consequence or effect, often negative:

sentences.en: The ______ of her decision was felt by everyone in the organization.
sentences.zh: 她這項決定所帶來的後果讓整個組織的每個人都感受到了。

sentences.en: Losing the contract had serious financial ______ for the company.
sentences.zh: 失去這份合約為公司帶來了嚴重的財務後果。

words.defn_en: works that an artist is prepared to perform:

sentences.en: The orchestra's ______ includes works from Beethoven to modern composers.
sentences.zh: 這支管弦樂團的曲目涵蓋了從貝多芬到現代作曲家的作品。

sentences.en: The chef expanded his ______ by learning new international dishes.
sentences.zh: 這位主廚透過學習新的國際料理,拓展了自己的拿手菜色。

sentences.en: The store staff worked to ______ the shelves before the holiday rush.
sentences.zh: 店員在假期人潮湧入前忙著補貨上架。

sentences.en: Drinking water regularly helps ______ the body's fluids after exercise.
sentences.zh: 運動後定時補充水分有助於恢復體內的水分。

sentences.en: The museum's new exhibit is ______ with fascinating artifacts from ancient Egypt.
sentences.zh: 博物館的新展覽充滿了來自古埃及的迷人文物。

sentences.en: His speech was ______ with statistics and expert opinions.
sentences.zh: 他的演講中充滿了統計數據和專家意見。

words.defn_en: capable of being reproduced or repeated:

sentences.en: The experiment was designed to be ______, allowing others to verify the results.
sentences.zh: 這項實驗的設計是為了可以被重複進行,讓其他人得以驗證結果。

sentences.en: The experiment's results were ______.
sentences.zh: 這項實驗的結果是可以被重複驗證的。

sentences.en: After the long journey, she finally found a moment of ______ by the fireplace.
sentences.zh: 經過漫長的旅程,她終於在壁爐旁找到片刻的休息。

sentences.en: The garden offered a peaceful place of ______ away from the city's noise.
sentences.zh: 這座花園是遠離城市喧囂、寧靜休憩的地方。

sentences.en: The court called the company's actions ______ and imposed a heavy fine.
sentences.zh: 法院譴責這家公司的行為應受懲處,並處以重額罰款。

sentences.en: His ______ treatment of his employees eventually led to a lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 他對待員工應受譴責的方式,最終導致了一場訴訟。

words.defn_en: a person acting on behalf of others:

sentences.en: The company's ______ spoke at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的代表在會議上發言。

sentences.en: Each district elects its own ______ to the national assembly.
sentences.zh: 每個選區都會選出自己的代表進入國民大會。

sentences.en: She struggled to ______ her laughter during the solemn ceremony.
sentences.zh: 在莊嚴的儀式中,她努力壓抑自己的笑意。

sentences.en: The government used force to ______ any sign of protest.
sentences.zh: 政府動用武力鎮壓任何抗議的跡象。

sentences.en: Because the defendant needed surgery, the judge granted a ______.
sentences.zh: 由於被告需要動手術,法官准許暫緩執行。

sentences.en: The rain gave the exhausted firefighters a brief ______.
sentences.zh: 這場雨讓筋疲力盡的消防員獲得了片刻的喘息。

sentences.en: The teacher ______ed the students for talking during the exam.
sentences.zh: 老師譴責了在考試中講話的學生。

sentences.en: He received a formal ______ from his boss for arriving late every day.
sentences.zh: 他因為每天遲到而受到上司正式的譴責。

sentences.en: Her mother's silent ______ hurt more than any harsh words.
sentences.zh: 母親無聲的責備比任何嚴厲的話語都更讓她難受。

sentences.en: He couldn't bear the ______ in his coach's eyes after the loss.
sentences.zh: 落敗之後,他無法承受教練眼中流露出的責備。

sentences.en: The old ______ spent every night gambling away what little money he had.
sentences.zh: 這個墮落的老頭每晚都把僅有的一點錢拿去賭博揮霍。

sentences.en: The novel's ______ villain shows no remorse for his crimes.
sentences.zh: 這部小說中無恥的反派對自己的罪行毫無悔意。

words.defn_en: to speak to in a disapproving manner; to scold

sentences.en: The principal gently ______d the student for talking during the assembly.
sentences.zh: 校長溫和地責備這名學生在集會時說話。

sentences.en: She would often ______ her younger brother for his messy room.
sentences.zh: 她經常責備弟弟房間太過凌亂。

sentences.en: The senator was forced to ______ his earlier statement after public backlash.
sentences.zh: 這位參議員在遭到公眾強烈反對後,被迫收回先前的言論。

sentences.en: She decided to ______ the contract after discovering the hidden fees.
sentences.zh: 她發現隱藏費用後,決定拒絕承認這份合約。

sentences.en: The idea of eating insects was ______ to him.
sentences.zh: 吃昆蟲的想法讓他感到十分反感。

sentences.en: She found his dishonesty absolutely ______.
sentences.zh: 她覺得他的不誠實令人極度反感。

sentences.en: The defenders managed to ______ the enemy's first attack.
sentences.zh: 守軍成功擊退了敵人的第一波攻擊。

sentences.en: His rude behavior tends to ______ anyone who tries to be friendly.
sentences.zh: 他粗魯的行為往往讓任何想與他交好的人望而卻步。

sentences.en: She only buys medicine from a ______ pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 她只在信譽良好的藥局購買藥品。

sentences.en: The university partnered with several ______ hospitals for its medical program.
sentences.zh: 這所大學與數家信譽良好的醫院合作,推動其醫學課程。

words.defn_zh: 被普遍認為的/名義上的

sentences.en: He is ______ to be one of the wealthiest men in the city.
sentences.zh: 他被普遍認為是這座城市最富有的人之一。

sentences.en: The restaurant is ______ to serve the best noodles in town.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳被公認是鎮上麵食做得最好的地方。

sentences.en: She had all the ______ skills for the job.
sentences.zh: 她具備了這份工作所有必要的技能。

sentences.en: A valid passport is a ______ for international travel.
sentences.zh: 有效護照是國際旅行的必要條件。

words.defn_en: a demand for goods, usually made by an authority:

sentences.en: The military issued a ______ for additional medical supplies.
sentences.zh: 軍方發出了一項徵用命令,要求提供額外的醫療用品。

sentences.en: The department submitted a ______ for new laboratory equipment.
sentences.zh: 這個部門提交了一份新實驗室設備的請購單。

words.defn_en: to revoke, cancel, or repeal a law, order, or agreement:

sentences.en: The company decided to ______ the job offer after reviewing his application.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在審核他的申請後決定撤回這份工作邀約。

sentences.en: The city council voted to ______ the controversial ordinance.
sentences.zh: 市議會投票決定廢除這項具爭議性的法令。

words.defn_en: a rare or nonstandard term meaning to resume or begin again:
words.root_note: re- (again) + sumere (to take up), from Latin, altered form

sentences.en: The committee agreed to ______ discussions after the winter break.
sentences.zh: 委員會同意在寒假結束後重新展開討論。

sentences.en: Talks between the two sides will ______ next month.
sentences.zh: 雙方的談判將於下個月重新展開。

sentences.en: The city's main ______ dropped to dangerously low levels during the drought.
sentences.zh: 在這場乾旱期間,這座城市的主要水庫水位降到了危險的低點。

sentences.en: She drew upon a deep ______ of patience while teaching the toddlers.
sentences.zh: 在教導這些幼兒時,她動用了自己深厚的耐心儲備。

words.defn_en: able to recover quickly from difficulties; tough and adaptable:
words.defn_zh: 有韌性的/能迅速恢復的

sentences.en: She showed ______ strength after the accident, returning to work soon after.
sentences.zh: 在這場意外之後,她展現出堅韌的力量,很快就重返工作崗位。

sentences.en: Even after setbacks, the patient is very ______.
sentences.zh: 即使遭遇挫折,這位病人依然十分堅韌,恢復力很強。

sentences.en: She remained ______ in her decision despite pressure from her family.
sentences.zh: 儘管家人施壓,她仍對自己的決定堅定不移。

sentences.en: His ______ leadership helped the team through its most difficult season.
sentences.zh: 他堅定果決的領導,帶領球隊度過了最艱難的一個賽季。

sentences.en: Her ______ never wavered, even in the face of failure.
sentences.zh: 即使面對失敗,她的決心也從未動搖。

sentences.en: The team's ______ carried them through a difficult season.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍的決心讓他們撐過了艱難的賽季。

sentences.en: Being ______, she fixed the flat tire using only a hairpin and some tape.
sentences.zh: 她足智多謀,僅用一根髮夾和一些膠帶就修好了爆胎。

sentences.en: The survivors were praised for being ______ during the crisis.
sentences.zh: 這些倖存者因在危機中展現的機智應變而受到讚揚。

sentences.en: The bride looked ______ in her embroidered silk gown.
sentences.zh: 新娘身穿刺繡絲質禮服,看起來光彩奪目。

sentences.en: The cathedral's dome was ______ with gold mosaics.
sentences.zh: 這座大教堂的圓頂因金色馬賽克鑲嵌而燦爛奪目。

words.defn_zh: 回應迅速的/反應靈敏的

sentences.en: The team wanted to improve and was very ______ to feedback.
sentences.zh: 這個團隊渴望進步,對回饋意見的反應非常積極。

sentences.en: The company's customer service is known for being quick and ______.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的客服以反應迅速且積極聞名。

sentences.en: The court ordered the company to make ______ to the affected families.
sentences.zh: 法院下令這家公司對受影響的家庭做出賠償。

sentences.en: He offered to make ______ for the damage he had caused years earlier.
sentences.zh: 他主動提出要為多年前造成的損害做出賠償。

sentences.en: The ______ crowd grew louder as the delayed concert failed to start.
sentences.zh: 隨著延遲的演唱會遲遲未能開始,這群焦躁的群眾變得越來越喧鬧。

sentences.en: The ______ horse refused to stand still during the fitting.
sentences.zh: 這匹難以駕馭的馬在試穿馬具時不肯乖乖站定。

words.defn_en: to bring back to original condition:

sentences.en: The architecture team carefully ______ the old house.
sentences.zh: 這支建築團隊細心修復了這棟老房子。

sentences.en: The new medication helped ______ his energy levels.
sentences.zh: 這種新藥有助於恢復他的體力。

sentences.en: Even though Tom was furious, he ______ his anger.
sentences.zh: 儘管湯姆非常憤怒,他還是克制住了自己的怒氣。

sentences.en: Security had to ______ the excited fans from rushing the stage.
sentences.zh: 保全人員必須阻止興奮的粉絲衝上舞台。

words.defn_en: controlled, limited, or held back; not excessive or extreme in expression:

sentences.en: His ______ behavior at the meeting showed professionalism and composure.
sentences.zh: 他在會議上克制自持的表現展現出專業與沉著。

sentences.en: The film's ______ use of special effects made the story feel more realistic.
sentences.zh: 這部電影節制地使用特效,讓故事顯得更加真實。

sentences.en: The school's ______ dress code left little room for personal expression.
sentences.zh: 這所學校嚴格的服裝規定讓學生幾乎沒有個人表現的空間。

sentences.en: Some countries have very ______ laws regarding freedom of speech.
sentences.zh: 有些國家對言論自由訂有非常嚴格限制的法律。

sentences.en: I use this pitcher to ______ water for my herb garden.
sentences.zh: 我用這個水壺來儲存澆灌香草花園的水。

sentences.en: The company struggled to ______ its top employees amid the industry-wide layoffs.
sentences.zh: 在整個產業普遍裁員的情況下,這家公司很難留住頂尖員工。

sentences.en: After Celia yelled at Dom, he ______ with a counterattack.
sentences.zh: 西莉亞對唐姆大吼之後,他也以反擊回應。

sentences.en: The nation vowed to ______ against the unprovoked attack.
sentences.zh: 這個國家誓言要對這場無端的攻擊進行報復。

sentences.en: He remained ______ about his plans, refusing to answer any questions.
sentences.zh: 他對自己的計畫保持沉默,拒絕回答任何問題。

sentences.en: She is usually ______ in large groups but talkative among close friends.
sentences.zh: 她在人多的場合通常沉默寡言,但和好友在一起時卻很健談。

sentences.en: He remained ______ about his plans, refusing to answer any questions.
sentences.zh: 他對自己的計畫保持沉默,拒絕回答任何問題。

sentences.en: She is usually ______ in large groups but talkative among close friends.
sentences.zh: 她在人多的場合通常沉默寡言,但和好友在一起時卻很健談。

sentences.en: "I never asked for your opinion," she ______ed sharply.
sentences.zh: 「我從沒問過你的意見,」她尖銳地反駁道。

sentences.en: He was quick to ______ whenever someone questioned his methods.
sentences.zh: 每當有人質疑他的方法,他總是很快就會反駁回去。

sentences.en: The newspaper was forced to ______ its false claim the following day.
sentences.zh: 這家報社隔天被迫撤回其不實的報導內容。

sentences.en: He refused to ______ his statement, even under pressure from his lawyers.
sentences.zh: 即使受到律師的壓力,他仍拒絕撤回自己的聲明。

words.root_note: re- (again) + bellare (to war, hence rebellare, revel)

sentences.en: The team continued to ______ in their unexpected victory long into the night.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍徹夜狂歡,慶祝這場意外的勝利。

sentences.en: She loves to ______ in the quiet beauty of an early morning walk.
sentences.zh: 她非常喜歡沉浸在清晨散步那份寧靜的美好之中。
